name: Hail to the Thief
tagline: VIctory build for NVIDIA cards with 12GB or less
rig: RTX 3060 12GB · Ryzen 5 5600X · 32GB · Series S profile + DLSS Quality
notes: Played by hand past the prologue into chapter one. With AMD FSR 3 frame generation (on by default): about 29 fps shown in chapter one (14.4 rendered). Without it: 16-21 fps in the opening room, 13-16 in chapter one; drops at cutscene transitions. No ray tracing yet: its light is stood in for, now with contact shadows (ground-truth ambient occlusion) and bounce light between nearby surfaces, and reflections that work indoors (no frost on sunlit floors, no glowing eyes or glass, no white specks in the air), all at no measured cost. Window glass still looks frosted. The title's own ray tracing runs on the RTX 3060 but costs about 30% and is not yet right to look at.
